review_scope: Early Advanced integrated whole-image direction gate, not full delivery acceptance
question: Does combined HEAD01+BODY01 show meaningful net source-alignment progress over immutable09, and which modules should remain in the next integration?
criteria: At identical camera, displayed size, neutral lighting and clay settings, whole-character gains must be visible and outweigh introduced regressions.
Assess coupled head/bill/cheek and rounded breast construction; preserve useful09 bird identity, compact shield, optic, stance and exposed flank.
Do not substitute higher detail counts, preserved hashes or worker opinions for likeness.
Technical claims are bounded to actual readbacks; source camera and manual depth are estimates.
Absent combined head/body/profile/rear, other era or browser evidence remains not-run; no final source or owner acceptance is inferred.
Reviewer recommends retain-with-limits, reject, or smallest decisive additional comparison.
limits: All pinned sources are optimizer-seen, no protected holdout.
QA agents have separate reused contexts, shared model/source limitations must be recorded.
Only Advanced combined whole PBR/clay is ready; worker regional views are separately archived.

claims.claim: Current whole baseline and candidate were produced from exact saved09 at identical saved camera/light/render settings.
Original receiving payloads, material graphs and packed images survive candidate save/reopen unchanged except declared retirement visibility.
Combined regional proposal is a useful net whole-character likeness gain over09.
Both head and breast modules independently contribute enough to retain.
